verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships an official CLI (nitropy), confirmed by a runtime probe to install from PyPI as a 'Command line tool to interact with Nitrokey devices', plus an official Python SDK, so programmatic device access is plausible. However, no evidence shows these tools reading the specific state fields the story asks for, and nothing documents fleet-level audit workflows. Missing for 10: documented reads of serial number, firmware version, enabled applications, and stored-credential inventory; machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output for agents; fleet-audit guidance; hands-on corroboration of state queries.
